card.name: Noun right after a qualifier
card.fires_on: A noun or number that follows a describing word, such as a group, grade or amount, e.g. 'greatest risk', 'Russian membership', 'single dose', 'Grade 4'. The marked word is the head noun that completes a short qualified phrase.
